dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients located primarily in the anterior-ventral and lower-central regions of the visible flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent posterior-dorsal macro-annuli form an irregular scalene triangle; these points relate to a lower cluster of high-intensity blobs through a broad, asymmetric polygonal network.
